metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: a richer footer and a crab buddy above the prompt.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: A footer showing the model and effort, how full the context window is, and the prompt cache, with one-click compact and clear

plugins.name: crab-buddy
plugins.description: A pixel-art Claude crab above the prompt that works, thinks, cheers and sleeps with the session, with a small crab in its own color for each subagent
